verses.en: In the land of the Chaldeans, at the residence of my fathers, I, Abraham, saw that it was needful for me to obtain another place of residence;
verses.sm: I Le laueleele o sā Kaletaia, i le nofoaga o o’u tamā, o a’u, o Aperaamo, sa vaai ua tatau ia te a’u ona maua se isi mea ou te nofo ai;

verses.en: And, finding there was greater happiness and peace and rest for me, I sought for the blessings of the fathers, and the right whereunto I should be ordained to administer the same; having been myself a follower of righteousness, desiring also to be one who possessed great knowledge, and to be a greater follower of righteousness, and to possess a greater knowledge, and to be a father of many nations, a prince of peace, and desiring to receive instructions, and to keep the commandments of God, I became a rightful heir, a High Priest, holding the right belonging to the fathers.
verses.sm: Ma, ina ua ou iloa e i ai se fiafia tele atu ma se filemu ma se mapusaga mo a’u, sa ou saili i faamanuiaga a tamā, ma le aiā e tatau ona faauu i ai a’u e taulimaina ia lava faamanuiaga; aua sa avea a’u o se soo o le amiotonu, i le manao foi ia avea ma se tasi ua mauaina le malamalama tele, ma avea o se soo sili atu o le amiotonu, ma maua se malamalama sili atu, ma avea o se tamā o atunuu e tele, o se aloalii o le filemu, ma manao e maua faatonuga, ma tausi i poloaiga a le Atua, sa avea a’u ma suli moni, o se Faitaulaga Sili, ua umia le aiā e a tamā.

verses.en: It was conferred upon me from the fathers; it came down from the fathers, from the beginning of time, yea, even from the beginning, or before the foundation of the earth, down to the present time, even the right of the firstborn, or the first man, who is Adam, or first father, through the fathers unto me.
verses.sm: Sa faaee mai i o’u luga mai tamā; sa faasolo ifo mai i tamā, mai i le amataga o taimi, ioe, mai i le amataga lava, pe a o le i faavaeina le lalolagi, seia oo mai i le taimi nei, le aiā lava lea a le ulumatua, po o le uluai tagata, o Atamu lea, po o le uluai tamā, e ala mai i tamā ia te a’u.

verses.en: I sought for mine appointment unto the Priesthood according to the appointment of God unto the fathers concerning the seed.
verses.sm: Sa ou saili i lo’u tofiga i le Perisitua e tusa ma le tofiga a le Atua i tamā e faatatau i le fanau.

verses.en: My fathers, having turned from their righteousness, and from the holy commandments which the Lord their God had given unto them, unto the worshiping of the gods of the heathen, utterly refused to hearken to my voice;
verses.sm: Ona sa liliu ese o’u tamā mai i lo latou amiotonu, ma mai poloaiga paia na tuu mai ia te i latou e le Alii lo latou Atua, i le tapuai atu i atua o tagata faapaupau, sa matua mumusu lava e faalogo mai i lo’u leo;

w.en: which had been delivered to them

verses.en: For their hearts were set to do evil, and were wholly turned to the god of Elkenah, and the god of Libnah, and the god of Mahmackrah, and the god of Korash, and the god of Pharaoh, king of Egypt;
verses.sm: Ona sa naunau o latou loto e fai le leaga, ma sa liliu atoatoa atu i le atua o Elekana, ma le atua o Lipena, ma le atua o Mamakara, ma le atua o Korasi, ma le Atua o Farao, le tupu o Aikupito;

verses.en: Therefore they turned their hearts to the sacrifice of the heathen in offering up their children unto these dumb idols, and hearkened not unto my voice, but endeavored to take away my life by the hand of the priest of Elkenah. The priest of Elkenah was also the priest of Pharaoh.
verses.sm: O lea na liliu atu ai o latou loto i le taulaga a tagata faapaupau i le taulagaina atu o a latou fanau i ia tupua lē gagana, ma lē faalogo mai i lo’u leo, a ua taumafai e aveese lo’u ola i le lima o le faitaulaga a Elekana. O le faitaulaga a Elekana o le faitaulaga foi lea a Farao.

verses.en: Now, at this time it was the custom of the priest of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to offer up upon the altar which was built in the land of Chaldea, for the offering unto these strange gods, men, women, and children.
verses.sm: O lenei, o le taimi lea, sa o se tu a le faitaulaga a Farao, le tupu o Aikupito, le osi atu o taulaga i luga o le fatafaitaulaga sa fausia i le laueleele o Kaletaia, mo le taulaga atu i ia atua ese, o tane, fafine, ma tamaiti.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the priest made an offering unto the god of Pharaoh, and also unto the god of Shagreel, even after the manner of the Egyptians. Now the god of Shagreel was the sun.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina osia atu e le faitaulaga se taulaga i le atua o Farao, ma i le atua foi o Sakaira, e tusa lava ma le tu a tagata Aikupito. O lenei o le atua o Sakaira o le la.

verses.en: Even the thank-offering of a child did the priest of Pharaoh offer upon the altar which stood by the hill called Potiphar’s Hill, at the head of the plain of Olishem.
verses.sm: E oo i le taulaga-faafetai e osi i se tamaitiiti sa faia e le faitaulaga a Farao i luga o le fatafaitaulaga sa tu i tafatafa o le mauga sa ta’ua o le Mauga o Potifara, i le amataga o le fanua laugatasi o Olisema.

verses.en: Now, this priest had offered upon this altar three virgins at one time, who were the daughters of Onitah, one of the royal descent directly from the loins of Ham. These virgins were offered up because of their virtue; they would not bow down to worship gods of wood or of stone, therefore they were killed upon this altar, and it was done after the manner of the Egyptians.
verses.sm: O lenei, sa osi atu e lenei faitaulaga i luga o lenei fatafaitaulaga ni taupou e toatolu i le taimi e tasi, o afafine ia o Onaita, o se tasi o le gafa tautupu e tupuga tonu lava mai sulugatiti o Hamo. O ia taupou sa ofoina atu ona o lo latou amiomamā; sa latou lē fia ifo i lalo e tapuai atu i atua laau po o maa, o lea na fasiotia ai i latou i luga o lenei fatafaitaulaga, ma sa faia e tusa ma le tu a tagata Aikupito.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the priests laid violence upon me, that they might slay me also, as they did those virgins upon this altar; and that you may have a knowledge of this altar, I will refer you to the representation at the commencement of this record.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faaoo mai e faitaulaga le faasaua i o’u luga, ina ia latou fasioti ia te a’u, e pei ona sa latou faia i na taupou i luga o lenei fatafaitaulaga; ma ina ia outou maua se malamalama e uiga i lenei fatafaitaulaga, o le a ou faasino atu outou i le ata faatusa o loo i le amataga o lenei talafaamaumau.

verses.en: It was made after the form of a bedstead, such as was had among the Chaldeans, and it stood before the gods of Elkenah, Libnah, Mahmackrah, Korash, and also a god like unto that of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
verses.sm: Sa fausia lenei fatafaitaulaga i foliga o se moega, e faapei ona sa i ai i tagata Kaletaia, ma sa tu i luma o atua o Elekana, Lipena, Mamakara, Korasi, ma le atua foi e pei o le atua o Farao, le tupu o Aikupito.

verses.en: That you may have an understanding of these gods, I have given you the fashion of them in the figures at the beginning, which manner of figures is called by the Chaldeans Rahleenos, which signifies hieroglyphics.
verses.sm: Ina ia outou malamalama e uiga i ia atua, ua ou tuu atu ia te outou ni faatusa o i latou i ni faatagata i le amataga, o ni ituaiga o faatagata ua ta’ua e tagata Kaletaia o Relino, o lona uiga o hairokilifi.

verses.en: And as they lifted up their hands upon me, that they might offer me up and take away my life, behold, I lifted up my voice unto the Lord my God, and the Lord hearkened and heard, and he filled me with the vision of the Almighty, and the angel of his presence stood by me, and immediately unloosed my bands;
verses.sm: Ma a’o sii a’e o latou lima i o’u luga, ina ia latou osi atu a’u ma aveese lo’u ola, faauta, sa ou siitia a’e i luga lo’u leo i le Alii lo’u Atua, ma sa faafofoga ma lagonaina e le Alii, ma sa ia faatumuina a’u i se faaaliga vaaia o le Malosi Aoao, ma sa tulai mai i o’u tafatafa se agelu mai ona luma, ma tatala o’u noanoaga i le taimi lava lea;

verses.en: And his voice was unto me: Abraham, Abraham, behold, my name is Jehovah, and I have heard thee, and have come down to deliver thee, and to take thee away from thy father’s house, and from all thy kinsfolk, into a strange land which thou knowest not of;
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai lona siufofoga ia te a’u: Aperaamo, Aperaamo e, faauta, o lo’u igoa o Ieova, ma ua Ou faalogoina oe, ma ua Ou sau i lalo e laveai oe, ma aveese oe mai le fale o lou tamā, ma mai i tagata uma o lou aiga, i se laueleele ese e te lē iloa lona uiga;

verses.en: And this because they have turned their hearts away from me, to worship the god of Elkenah, and the god of Libnah, and the god of Mahmackrah, and the god of Korash, and the god of Pharaoh, king of Egypt; therefore I have come down to visit them, and to destroy him who hath lifted up his hand against thee, Abraham, my son, to take away thy life.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ona ua latou liliu ese o latou loto mai ia te a’u, e tapuai atu i le atua o Elekana, ma le atua o Lipena, ma le atua o Mamakara, ma le atua o Korasi, ma le atua o Farao, le tupu o Aikupito; o lea ua Ou sau ai i lalo e asiasi mai ia te i latou, ma faaumatia o ia o lē ua siitia a’e i luga lona lima e faasaga ia te oe, Aperaamo e, lo’u atalii, e aveese lou ola.

verses.en: Behold, I will lead thee by my hand, and I will take thee, to put upon thee my name, even the Priesthood of thy father, and my power shall be over thee.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le a Ou taitai oe i lo’u lima, ma o le a Ou ave oe, e tuu i ou luga lo’u igoa, o le Perisitua lava lea o lou tamā, ma o le a i ai i ou luga lo’u mana.

verses.en: As it was with Noah so shall it be with thee; but through thy ministry my name shall be known in the earth forever, for I am thy God.
verses.sm: E faapei ona sa faia ia Noa o le a faapea foi ona faia ia te oe; ae o lau auaunaga o le a ala atu ai ona iloa o lo’u igoa i le lalolagi e faavavau, ona o A’u o lou Atua.

verses.en: Behold, Potiphar’s Hill was in the land of Ur, of Chaldea. And the Lord broke down the altar of Elkenah, and of the gods of the land, and utterly destroyed them, and smote the priest that he died; and there was great mourning in Chaldea, and also in the court of Pharaoh; which Pharaoh signifies king by royal blood.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le Mauga o Potifara sa i le laueleele o Uro, o Kaletaia. Ma sa lepeti i lalo e le Alii le fatafaitaulaga o Elekana, ma atua o le laueleele, ma matua faaumatia lava i latou, ma taia le faitaulaga na oo ina oti ai o ia; ma sa i ai se faanoanoa tele i Kaletaia, ma i le malae foi o Farao; o le Farao lea o lona uiga o le tupu e ala i le toto tautupu.

verses.en: Now this king of Egypt was a descendant from the loins of Ham, and was a partaker of the blood of the Canaanites by birth.
verses.sm: O lenei o lea tupu o Aikupito o se na tupuga mai i sulugatiti o Hamo, ma o se sa i ai le toto o sa Kananā i le fanau mai.

verses.en: From this descent sprang all the Egyptians, and thus the blood of the Canaanites was preserved in the land.
verses.sm: Mai lea gafa na tupuga mai ai tagata Aikupito uma, ma sa faapea ona faasaoina o le toto o sa Kananā i le laueleele.

verses.en: The land of Egypt being first discovered by a woman, who was the daughter of Ham, and the daughter of Egyptus, which in the Chaldean signifies Egypt, which signifies that which is forbidden;
verses.sm: Ona o le laueleele o Aikupito sa maua muamua e se fafine, o lē o se afafine o Hamo, ma se tama teine a Aikupeta, o lona uiga i le faa-Kaletaia o Aikupito, o lona uiga o se mea ua faasaina;

verses.en: When this woman discovered the land it was under water, who afterward settled her sons in it; and thus, from Ham, sprang that race which preserved the curse in the land.
verses.sm: Ina ua maua e lenei fafine le laueleele sa i lalo o le vai, o lē na ia faanonofo ai ana tama tane ina ua mavae lea; ma sa faapea, ona tupuga mai ia Hamo o le ituaiga lena na tumau ai le fetuu i le laueleele.

verses.en: Now the first government of Egypt was established by Pharaoh, the eldest son of Egyptus, the daughter of Ham, and it was after the manner of the government of Ham, which was patriarchal.
verses.sm: O lenei o le uluai malo o Aikupito sa faatuina e Farao, le tama tane matua a Aikupeta, le afafine o Hamo; ma sa faia e tusa ai ma le faiga o le malo o Hamo, sa faapeteriaka.

verses.en: Pharaoh, being a righteous man, established his kingdom and judged his people wisely and justly all his days, seeking earnestly to imitate that order established by the fathers in the first generations, in the days of the first patriarchal reign, even in the reign of Adam, and also of Noah, his father, who blessed him with the blessings of the earth, and with the blessings of wisdom, but cursed him as pertaining to the Priesthood.
verses.sm: O Farao, ona o ia se tagata amiotonu, sa ia faatuina lona malo ma faamasino lona nuu i le poto ma le fai mea tonu i ona aso uma, ma saili ma le maelega e faataitai i le faatulagaga lena sa faatuina e tamā i tupulaga muamua, i aso o le uluai nofoaiga faapeteriaka, i le nofoaiga lava a Atamu, ma Noa foi lona tamā, o lē na faamanuia ia te ia i faamanuiaga o le lalolagi, ma faamanuiaga o le poto, ae fetuu ia te ia e tusa ma le Perisitua.

verses.en: Now, Pharaoh being of that lineage by which he could not have the right of Priesthood, notwithstanding the Pharaohs would fain claim it from Noah, through Ham, therefore my father was led away by their idolatry;
verses.sm: O lenei, ona o Farao o se tasi o le gafa lena e lē mafai ona maua ai e ia le aiā o le Perisitua, e ui ina fai mai Farao na latou mauaina mai ia Noa, e ala mai ia Hamo, o lea na taitaieseina ai lo’u tamā e lo latou ifo i tupua;

verses.en: But I shall endeavor, hereafter, to delineate the chronology running back from myself to the beginning of the creation, for the records have come into my hands, which I hold unto this present time.
verses.sm: Ae o le a ou taumafai, i se taimi o mulimuli mai, e faamatala manino atu le faasologa e agai i tua mai ia te a’u i le amataga o le foafoaga, ona ua oo mai talafaamaumau i o’u lima, ia ua ou umia e oo mai i le taimi nei.

verses.en: Now, after the priest of Elkenah was smitten that he died, there came a fulfilment of those things which were said unto me concerning the land of Chaldea, that there should be a famine in the land.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina ua uma ona taia o le faitaulaga a Elekana na oti ai o ia, sa oo mai se faataunuuga o mea sa fai mai ia te a’u e uiga i le laueleele o Kaletaia, e faapea o le a oo mai se oge i le laueleele.

verses.en: Accordingly a famine prevailed throughout all the land of Chaldea, and my father was sorely tormented because of the famine, and he repented of the evil which he had determined against me, to take away my life.
verses.sm: E tusa ai ma lea, sa faateteleina se oge i le laueleele atoa o Kaletaia, ma sa mafatia tele lo’u tamā ona o le oge, ma sa salamo o ia i le leaga sa gauai o ia e fai faasaga mai ia te a’u, e aveese lo’u ola.

verses.en: But the records of the fathers, even the patriarchs, concerning the right of Priesthood, the Lord my God preserved in mine own hands; therefore a knowledge of the beginning of the creation, and also of the planets, and of the stars, as they were made known unto the fathers, have I kept even unto this day, and I shall endeavor to write some of these things upon this record, for the benefit of my posterity that shall come after me.
verses.sm: Ae o talafaamaumau o tamā, le au peteriaka lava lea, e faatatau i le aiā o le Perisitua, sa faasaoina e le Alii lo’u Atua i o’u lava lima; o lea o le malamalama e uiga i le amataga o le foafoaga, ma paneta foi, ma fetu foi, e pei ona faaalia i tamā, ua ou tausia e oo mai lava i le aso nei, ma o le a ou taumafai e tusi ni isi o ia mea i luga o lenei talafaamaumau, mo le manuia o a’u fanau o ē o le a o mai mulimuli mai ia te a’u.
